response.query: What specific IV candidates and exclusion restrictions can we pre-specify, what falsification/placebo tests will we run, and how will we define event‑study windows to avoid staggered DiD bias?
response.answer: For IV candidates, use pre-treatment policy changes; exclusion restrictions rely on pre-treatment trends. Falsification tests include placebo dates; event-study windows span pre- and post-treatment periods to detect bias.
